programme.title: Dropped - S02:E04 - Now or Never
programme.desc: As the mist drifts past the craggy top of Fish Hook, the crew's shapes slowly come into view right where the ram had been resting. Did they fire without Chris hearing the sound?

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E07 - Operation Spotted Dog
programme.desc: Working to protect our treasured natural resources in some of the country's most secluded spots means there's never a boring day on the job.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E08 - Operation Boat Float
programme.desc: In the shade of the wild mountains, the Yellowstone River transforms into a colorful spectacle during the yearly boat float weekend. Armed with jet boats, the Wardens gear up for a wild time, looking out for the river and helping out the wacky rafters.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E01 - Riggins Gold
programme.desc: Today on Gold Fever join Tom and his daughter Kia, are on the mighty Salmon River, doing some underwater metal detecting, looking for gold nuggets.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E02 - Blue Bucket Oregon Trail
programme.desc: Today on Gold Fever join Tom and his daughter Kia, are on the Oregon trail, hunting for the legendary Blue Bucket Mine.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E04 - Dying Hard
programme.desc: John McLain (Bruce Willis) finds himself dangling from the side of a building. The only way to save himself is to shoot through the glass window and break through to safety. Using the same Beretta 92 handgun, we reconstruct the office glass and see if our host can break through.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E05 - Schapbo
programme.desc: John Rambo's ability to decimate enemies all by himself has created some of the most incredible weapon stunts in Hollywood history. We test the reality surrounding these iconic scenes from this blockbuster franchise.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E17 - Remembering Diana Princess Of Wales
programme.desc: Remembering Diana, Princess of Wales includes scenes from her state funeral and heartfelt words from her closest friends. It's a warm and reflective look at Diana both as a person and a public figure: the queen that never was and the princess who'll always be remembered.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E12 - The New Royals
programme.desc: Princesses Beatrice and Eugenie have gone through a lot of media attention and tough situations in their lives. From their parents' very public split to being targeted by the press, they've been through quite a bit. Despite all this, they remain dedicated to supporting the monarchy with their charity work. programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E01 - The Secret Lives of Tigers
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Siberian tigers are the largest of all cats. In historic times, the tiger's range was vast, covering much of Asia. Over the last century, they've experienced an almost total population crash, and at least 97% of those tigers have gone.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E02 - The Secret Lives of Snow Leopards
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Often referred to as the gray ghost or ghost of the mountains, this animal's rarity and elusiveness was legendary. In the past, it was known as the ounce, but today we've settled on the name snow leopard.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E03 - The Secret Lives of Pumas
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Pumas are also known by the names of cougar or mountain lion. However, these cats are only distantly related to lions. They're much more closely related to cheetahs. And while pumas are often found in mountains, they're just as at home in the lowlands, dense forests, treeless pampers, or deserts.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E04 - The Secret Lives of Lions
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Lions differ from all other cats in that they are highly social, forming prides of up to 35 animals. There are now thought to be fewer than 15,000 lions remaining in Kenya's Masai Mara, a drop of 75% in 50 years.

programme.desc: E’ il giorno della finale a Hell’s Kitchen. I cuochi si svegliano e trovano sul tavolo una sorpresa: ci sono 4 buste per loro.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen Italy
programme.desc: I concorrenti alloggiano nel loft di Hell's Kitchen e hanno una notte intera per studiare il menu che serviranno la sera successiva. Durante la notte i concorrenti vengono svegliati continuamente da una sirena e su un televisore assistono alle lezioni di cucina dello Chef Cracco. Alle 8:00 i concorrenti scendono nelle cucine e Cracco mostra loro come tagliare la carne per fare il filetto alla Rossini.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen Italy
programme.desc: Il servizio non va bene e Cracco è costretto a chiudere anticipatamente prima la cucina blu e poi la cucina rossa. I concorrenti vengono mandati nel loft e hanno 30 minuti di tempo per decidere i loro nominati per l'eliminazione. La squadra rossa nomina Lorena e Amelia, la squadra blu Andrea e Gene.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen Italy
programme.desc: Le due squadre si affrontano in una sfida diretta sull'assaggio: i due concorrenti, bendati e dotati di cuffie, devono individuare quattro diversi alimenti solo assaggiandoli; vince la squadra che indovina il maggior numero di alimenti. La prova termina in parità, quindi vi è uno spareggio fra i concorrenti più forti delle due squadre (Lorenza e Gianluca) che determina la vittoria dei rossi. Per punizione, la squadra blu deve pulire 90 kg di pesce per il servizio, mentre la squadra rossa si gode alcune ore in un centro benessere.

programme.title: Pingu

programme.desc: Pingu vuole usare la macchina per maglieria della mamma. Quando lei riposa, Pingu ne approfitta per sferruzzare a più non posso! | È ora di dormire, ma Pingu e Pinga giocano ancora fuori. | Pingu e Pinga giocano a rincorrersi. Pingu crede di essere scappato, ma resta bloccato.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.desc: Pingu e Pinga trovano degli adesivi nella loro scatola di cereali e iniziano a etichettare le cose. | Pingu sa di essere nei guai quando rompe il campanello dell'igloo. | Robby è estremamente bravo a far stare in equilibrio un pesce sulla punta del naso.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.desc: Pingu fa cadere una bottiglia di latte che rotola in un burrone ghiacciato. | Pingu prepara frittelle, ma la pastella vola ovunque mentre cerca di girarle.| La mamma serve pappa di pesce per cena – e a Pingu non piace per niente l'odore!

programme.title: Pingu
programme.desc: Pingu scopre che più lontano fa rotolare le sue palle di neve, più diventano grandi. | Pingu usa un tubo e un imbuto per fare scherzi alla sua famiglia e ai suoi amici. | Pingu vuole provare il tornio del nonno, ma le sue ceramiche non sono neanche lontanamente belle come quelle del nonno.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.desc: Quando Pingu e Pinga giocano in modo troppo turbolento, rovinano il cappello nuovo della mamma. | Pingu getta l'involucro a terra; tutti lo imitano, creando disordine.| Pingu è un tipo un po' scatenato quando si tratta di andare in slitta.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.desc: Pingu è geloso delle attenzioni che riceve la sorella malata... così finge di essere malato anche lui! | Pingu e Pinga decidono di fare uno scherzo a sorpresa alla mamma mettendo Pinga in una vecchia scatola. | Pingu è invitato a una festa di compleanno, ma non vuole che anche Pinga ci vada.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.desc: L'insegnante di Pingu sta mostrando alla classe come creare forme di cartapesta, e Pingu e i suoi amici ne sono colpiti. | Pingu non ne ha mai abbastanza dei suoi snack al pesce preferiti. | Papà dà a Pingu una lezione di guida, ma Pingu rompe accidentalmente la leva della velocità.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.desc: Pingu vuole un nuovo giocattolo, ma la mamma non glielo compra mentre fanno la spesa. | Pingu è incaricato di prendersi cura dell'animale della scuola. È un granchio scontroso a cui non piace Pingu. | Pingu semina il caos quando è costretto ad accompagnare la mamma al salone di bellezza.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.desc: Quando Pinga si batte il dito del piede, Pingu si diverte un mondo a fasciare il piede dolorante e a farla ridacchiare. | Pingu trova un flauto magico, ma nessuno sembra apprezzare i suoi rumorosi fischi... tranne i pesci! | Pingi sembra preferire giocare con Pingo che con Pingu.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.desc: Pingu promette di catturare un pesce GRANDE per la mamma, ma nei buchi per la pesca, pesca solo spazzatura! | Pingu gioca con le bretelle del nonno, correndo finché l'elastico non lo tira indietro. | Pingu ottiene un lavoro come giornalaio e non vede l'ora di iniziare.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.desc: Pingu sta dipingendo quando rovescia accidentalmente della vernice rossa e la situazione sfugge rapidamente al controllo. | Pingu vede un nuovo monopattino, ma Pingg lo compra per primo! | Pingu prova a tuffarsi per impressionare gli amici, ma scopre che non è affatto facile come sembra!

programme.title: Pingu
programme.desc: Pingu vuole far credere a Pinga che ci sia un abominevole uomo delle nevi in giro per l'Antartide. | Pingu sente una nuova canzone alla radio e non ne ha mai abbastanza. | Un amico di Pingu porta a scuola un aeroplanino a elastico e Pingu sostituisce l'elastico in modo che l'aereo voli più lontano.

programme.desc: Jana’s uneasy relationship with Imara is tested on a mission to find a dangerous wolfblood.

programme.title: S04 E05
programme.desc: TJ tries to help Selina with a problem that threatens to expose her as a wolfblood.

programme.title: S04 E06
programme.desc: With a Dark Moon looming the pack is fraying at the edges and Selina’s alter-ego is uncovered.

programme.title: S04 E07
programme.desc: When TJ falls for a human he’s in danger of breaking more than his heart.

programme.title: S04 E08
programme.desc: Jana and TJ are forced to find Carrie to avoid their secret being exposed.

programme.title: S04 E09
programme.desc: Jana’s mission to the wild pack ends in disaster.

programme.title: S01 E05 Something Fishy
programme.desc: Kim reads Cleo’s diary and finds evidence of mermaidness. She spies on the girls and decides Miriam is the head mermaid. Miriam and Cleo enter the Queen of the Sea contest where Kim tries to prove her theory but only succeeds in upsetting Miriam.

programme.title: S01 E06 Young Love
programme.desc: Rikki gains an admirer in Emma’s younger brother Elliot when she saves him from drowning. She lets him down hard causing him to run away and hide in the fernery. The girls find him just as the watering system is about to start.

programme.title: S01 E07 Moon Spell
programme.desc: The effects of the full moon turns Emma into a carefree, wild mermaid. At her father’s birthday party she’s the opposite to her usual, organised self. Can the other girls stop her before all is revealed?

programme.title: S01 E08 The Denman Affair
programme.desc: A charismatic newcomer, Dr Denman, tempts Lewis with the promise of scientific fame and fortune. Will he abandon his friends and risk their secret, all in the name of science?

programme.title: S01 E09 Dangerous Waters
programme.desc: Rikki uses her abilities as a mermaid to earn some quick cash but when she accidentally becomes involved in a fish smuggling operation she sets out to get her revenge.

programme.title: S01 E10 The Camera Never Lies
programme.desc: Zane tries to impress his dad by entering in the local film competition, filming his attempt to break his Dad’s windsurfing record around Mako Island. He gets into trouble with sharks and unbeknownst to him, is saved by mermaid Rikki.

programme.title: S04 E10
programme.desc: Jana must decide where she belongs.

programme.title: S04 E11
programme.desc: Jana’s world crumbles and a face from the past returns.

programme.title: S04 E12
programme.desc: Jana has to make a decision that will change the world forever.

programme.title: S05 E01
programme.desc: Jana makes the shock decision that this will be her last full moon in the city. While the pack wrestle with the disappointment of losing their alpha, TJ falls for the smoke and mirrors of movie producer Joshua Hartington. Meanwhile Katrina attempts to train ex-Segolia worker Robyn.

programme.title: S05 E02
programme.desc: The mystery wolfblood is unmasked and brings startling news from the Wild Pack. Jana summons the strength to help locate TJ, but her interference backfires with devastating consequences.

programme.title: S05 E03
programme.desc: The pack investigate the Segolia Vault and in doing so find the precious Dawnus Torc which takes them on an adventure like never before. TJ falls sick with a mystery illness.

programme.title: S01 E26 Normal Alex Wilson
programme.desc: At home, JB and Amanda try to convince the Wilson parents missing Alex will be back. With help from the people, brave Kuru cunningly frees Alex, Omar and Vashan, who shows them a rune to restore one's powers, but it can only be used with magic.

programme.title: S01 E01
programme.desc: Alexandra dreams of a singing career, in a pop band with friends Marcus, JB Deekes and Amanda Tucci. At her birthday party they get a complete surprise visit. The mysterious Indian Kuru, riding the often invisible elephant Anala, tells them she's in fact the magical princess-heir of Manjipour.

programme.title: S01 E02
programme.desc: After Kuru's visit, Alexandra's family is unusually accommodating. Kuru reports in Manjipoor that the princess isn't ready for the throne, but the guru is confident she'll grow into it and gives him the magical royal runes. Finding out she's adopted as Kuru said, she goes crazy, wants to run away and tears up a family picture.

programme.title: S01 E03
programme.desc: Alexandra orders Kuru to lie for her, which he reluctantly does after consulting Omar in Manshipoor, while Vashan would stick to the rule royalty must be truthful. She attempts first to pass off Kuru for an exchange student, while he openly treated her as princess.

programme.title: S01 E04
programme.desc: Alex takes guru Kuru to her class, but he doesn't fin there. So she (ab)uses magic to make him 'cool'.

programme.title: S03 E26 Graduation
programme.desc: Sophie and Ryan damage the Moon Pool in their efforts to obtain the rare crystals. The girls improvise and use their own magic to prevent the impact of the comet.

programme.title: S02 E01 Stormy Weather
programme.desc: Emma, Rikki and Cleo are teenage girls with a secret - they’re still mermaids. They’re handling life pretty well but the threat of the full moon, and the strange effects it has on mermaids, looms. This time Lewis is certain he can help but things go awry and the girls are moonstruck.

programme.title: S02 E02 Control
programme.desc: Cleo uses her mermaid powers to avoid a sprinkler and inadvertently splashes Charlotte, the new girl at school. Lewis and Charlotte meet and it’s clear she likes him straight away. With the girls’ mermaid powers turned up to max, Lewis tries his best to help but his attempts only cause Cleo to feel crowded by him.

programme.title: S02 E03 The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Zane’s back in town and still in love with Rikki. Although he believes she’s not a mermaid anymore, things are still tense between them. Rikki assures Emma she can handle Zane; they broke up and that’s all there is to it. As Zane continues to try to win Rikki’s affections, he realises she’s still a mermaid and saves her from the threat of discovery.

programme.title: S02 E04 Fire and Ice
programme.desc: Rikki comes to stay at Emma’s house and stirs up the family unit by messing up the order of things. In trying to compete with Rikki, Emma tries to rebel and throws a party. Meanwhile Lewis wants to know why Cleo broke up with him; concerned that he’s not masculine enough for her.

programme.title: S05 E04
programme.desc: Jana and Imara run into familiar faces as they track Hartington. Selina competes in the taekwondo fight of her life and in doing so makes an unlikely ally. Jeffries laments the end of his career.

programme.title: S05 E05
programme.desc: TJ’s good intentions land him in hot water with Selina. The Humans group target the Kafe. A face from the past returns to take action that will change everything.

programme.title: S05 E06
programme.desc: It’s dark moon day, Katrina’s Grandad has made the Kafe a wolfblood free zone and Emilia’s fate rests on Hannah. Imara and Jana make a breakthrough in proving the conspiracy, but who can they trust?

programme.title: S05 E07
programme.desc: Jana and the pack ask Emilia to tread carefully now that they suspect government officials are conspiring with Hartington to chip and de-wolf wolfbloods. But Emilia has no intention of backing down and makes a public display in the city, resulting in a devastating choice for wolfbloods everywhere.

programme.title: S05 E08
programme.desc: Unable to help Selina’s parents, Jana resolves to find a way to help the other trapped wolfbloods, starting with The Genesis Project. Matei returns to the den to seek Jana’s help in convincing Emilia that her vision of Blydissiad is false. But Madoc has his own secret agenda.

programme.title: S05 E09
programme.desc: Jana is forced to realise that she can’t save everyone and must make a decision about her future. TJ and Matei track Emilia but discover that Madoc is now pack leader. They join the journey to Blydissiad but are in for a shock. Katrina refuses to accept Robyn’s actions.

programme.title: S05 E10
programme.desc: Jana fulfils her promise to come after Hartington. Dr Whitewood discovers the amazing truth about Project Genesis. TJ finds himself with a huge responsibility.

programme.title: S01 E01
programme.desc: When ZOEY and KIKI, two irrepressible girls from another galaxy land in Lightning Point, their dreams of surfing the waves of Earth’s oceans have finally come true!

programme.title: S01 E02
programme.desc: With their space ship obliterated and no other way of getting home, KIKI and ZOEY settle into the teenage world of Lightning Point at AMBER’s house.

programme.title: S01 E03
programme.desc: To blend in, ZOEY and KIKI start attending AMBER’s school – and find it nothing like school on LUMINA.

programme.title: S01 E04
programme.desc: When KIKI is moved to tears by AMBER’s singing, AMBER makes an important discovery – Luminans can only experience emotions on Earth.

programme.title: S01 E05
programme.desc: Quadrupeds fascinate KIKI and when she finds out that LUCA’s horse BANDIT has been skittish and dangerous to ride ever since they arrived, she feels terrible.

programme.title: S01 E06
programme.desc: LUCA and KIKI have been growing closer and AMBER is sick of being stuck in the middle! Finally, LUCA asks KIKI out on a date – and KIKI can’t wait.

programme.title: S01 E07
programme.desc: When ZOEY escapes the washing up to recharge her energy, AMBER and KIKI think nothing of it – until a big burst of lightning strikes their house. Rushing upstairs, they find ZOEY gone.

programme.title: S01 E08
programme.desc: ZOEY is finding BRANDON a challenging surfing adversary. He’s even started to compliment her on her moves.

programme.title: S01 E09
programme.desc: As ZOEY, KIKI and AMBER head out to the Benedict cane field, owned by BRANDON and LUCA’s family, ZOEY is excited.

programme.title: S01 E10
programme.desc: With LUCA and BRANDON dangerously close to their secret, KIKI feels that they have no choice but to stick close to them, to find out what they really know.

programme.title: S01 E11
programme.desc: ZOEY is sick of waiting and decides to take charge of finding a way home. Back at the cane field, ZOEY and AMBER test out the energy field one more time.

programme.title: S01 E12
programme.desc: When a storm is forecast to hit Lightning Point, ZOEY and KIKI know it’s time – they can send a signal through the lightning, via the energy field and back to Lumina.

programme.title: S01 E13
programme.desc: KIKI and ZOEY are anxious – with no reply from Lumina and LUCA knowing who they are, they’re no longer safe in Lightning Point.

programme.title: S01 E14
programme.desc: Many weeks after the boat was discovered in the cane field, no clues have been found and no further message from Lumina has come.

programme.title: S01 E15
programme.desc: AMBER is totally excited when her crush, JOSH has noticed her at school. She’s doubly excited when he asks her to help organise a Hawaiian fundraiser party for his basketball team.

programme.title: S01 E16
programme.desc: When OLIVIA rings AMBER about a surprise waiting at home for her, AMBER would never have guessed that the surprise was her Dad KEITH!

programme.title: S01 E17
programme.desc: LUCA is finally letting his guard down with KIKI again – and soon they’re back to their old friendship.

programme.title: S01 E18
programme.desc: The gang decide not to let BRANDON know about the toy lighthouse until they know more about it.

programme.title: S01 E19
programme.desc: BRANDON and ZOEY are closer than ever and are keen to spend as much time together as possible.

programme.title: S01 E20
programme.desc: KIKI and ZOEY are relieved to find out that half-Luminan BRANDON can’t use the card properly. The only way they can be sure they are out of danger though, is to destroy the card.

programme.title: S01 E21
programme.desc: With BRANDON fully charged, ZOEY can’t help but feel that BRANDON needs to know the truth about her. How can she be his girlfriend and keep lying to him?

programme.title: S01 E22
programme.desc: BRANDON is furious with everyone – and especially ZOEY – for lying to him. How could they keep a secret like this from him?

programme.title: S01 E23
programme.desc: The day of the Lightning Point Junior Girls Surfing Competition is here and everyone from Lightning Point is ready to compete. Except ZOEY.

programme.title: S01 E11 Sink or Swim
programme.desc: Emma trains Byron for the swimming competition. At first they get along well and even share a kiss, but too soon Emma becomes the training dragon. Byron fires Emma but when he wins the comp he tries to hug her and she recoils.

programme.title: S01 E12 The Siren Effect
programme.desc: The full moon strikes Cleo, turning her into a magical siren, attracting all the young males in the vicinity. Cleo enjoys the attention and is encouraged to sing for them, but a concert at the Juice Bar as the moon sets reveals her truly awful voice.

programme.title: S01 E13 Shipwrecked
programme.desc: When the mysterious old woman’s boat and home is declared unseaworthy Emma invites her over to stay. Zane gets trapped on the sinking boat and Emma tries to save him.

programme.title: S01 E14 Surprise!
programme.desc: Cleo’s dad plans an embarrassing surprise party for her birthday so she escapes to Mako Island. Zane and Lewis almost spot her there on their expedition to catch the sea monster.

programme.title: S01 E15 The Big Chill
programme.desc: Emma is put in charge of managing the juice bar. Miriam decides to cause trouble and cuts the power to the cool room, then is unwittingly frozen by Emma who uses her powers to fix the freezer. Will the girls be able to thaw Miriam out?

programme.title: S01 E16 Lovesick
programme.desc: A dolphin at Sea World will only eat from Cleo’s hand and when she has to sneak out to feed him, everyone thinks she has a boyfriend.

programme.title: S01 E24
programme.desc: BRANDON is so excited by his alien energy that he starts to recharge – way too often.

programme.title: S01 E25
programme.desc: BRANDON is finally ready to learn who he truly is. As ZOEY speaks to him, she becomes more and more convinced that BRANDON has secrets locked inside his memories.

programme.title: S01 E26
programme.desc: AMBER, ZOEY and KIKI take a last surf of Lightning Point’s waves. ZOEY and KIKI will miss this place – and AMBER – when they leave for Lumina tonight with BRANDON.

programme.title: S01 E01
programme.desc: To help their friend Cleo get hired (as a volunteer) at the Dolphin City Oceanic Centre, Rikki, Emma and Lewis take her out free-diving off Mako Island, to see underwater wildlife in person! But when their motorboat’s engine fails, they have to spend the night on the island: that night, when Rikki, Emma and Cleo are exploring the island, they fall into a mysterious cave.

programme.title: S01 E02
programme.desc: Little Elliot gets his big sister Emma to enter the Grand Sand Sculpture contest with him. Meanwhile Cleo’s day starts badly at the Oceanic Center: Mr. Lambert puts her in charge of the new intern - Miriam, the Mayor’s daughter and high school pest! Miriam lives up to her reputation, and submits Cleo to a series of capricious outbursts.

programme.title: S01 E03
programme.desc: During a scientific experiment conducted by Lewis out at sea, the three mermaids find a wooden statue of a white mermaid on the seafloor! Lewis discovers it’s the figurehead of a famous pirate galleon, the White Mermaid, which sank at sea without a trace! Rikki and Emma are thrilled, while Cleo is preoccupied by something else.

programme.title: S01 E05
programme.desc: Amanda abuses magic for her guitar playing and forces Kuru to accept a rune, forbidden magic transfer. Kuru reports on her progress to Omar, who orders him to change and address the council.

programme.title: S01 E06
programme.desc: Alex still puts her teenager life above royal duty. Yet Manjipoor cheerfully awaits her return. Vashan and his servant Diva only pretend approval. Kuru visits Omar, who reassures him time should help.

programme.title: S01 E07
programme.desc: After Kuru reports Alex still doesn't concentrate on her magic training, Omar invites her. The elders decide to hold a banquet, Vashan prepares a snake venom-drink. Alex misses the appointment because she prefers to play with her band in a talent competition they only make trough her magic abuse.

programme.title: S01 E08
programme.desc: Amanda convinces Alex to visit Manjopoor, and shop at the oriental market. Anala drags along suspicious JB too. They end up in the magic forest and are mistaken for circus people by humble locals. Trying to help their son Johan, who was transformed into a mouse by Vashan for poaching.

programme.title: S01 E09
programme.desc: Despite Kuru's warning that love and magic don't mix, Alex tricks him to tell her a spell to prove if Marcus, who asked her on a band date, loves her. It turns her into a frog, which can only be undone by a kiss from a true lover.

programme.title: S02 E05 Hocus Pocus
programme.desc: Cleo notes that Don seems to be down since her mother left. Later, Lewis finds an old book on mermaids and tests out a potion recipe on the girls, supposed to grant wishes. Cleo instantly thinks it could help get Don and her Mum back together. They make the potion and it doesn’t seem to work.

programme.title: S02 E06 Pressure Cooker
programme.desc: Life isn’t the same at Cleo’s house since her mother left. When it appears that Don has a girlfriend - Cleo and Kim are horrified, thinking this means a step-mother. Meanwhile, Charlotte is making more moves on Lewis, making Cleo increasingly jealous. Don organises a dinner and Cleo is shocked to find her Dad’s new partner is Charlotte’s mother!

programme.title: S02 E07 In Hot Water
programme.desc: Cleo has been getting into some trouble with her boss Mrs Geddes at work and when Ronnie the dolphin splashes her, Cleo laughs and is fired. At the same time, Lewis finds himself in desperate need of a job after his laptop dies and, unbeknownst to him, he is offered Cleo’s old job. Upset, the girls use their mermaid powers to make the job unbearable for Lewis.

programme.title: S02 E08 Wrong Side of the Tracks
programme.desc: Riding their dirt bikes, Zane and Nate stop in a trailer park to look at a classic Harley. Nate steals a badge from the bike and Zane is busted by the owner - little does he know it’s Rikki’s dad. Later, embarrassed by her family’s financial situation, Rikki hides where she really lives from Zane. Rikki has to overcome her shame about her background and introduce her dad to Zane.

programme.title: S02 E09 Riding for a Fall
programme.desc: Elliot is going to horse riding lessons and Emma is cornered into taking him. Emma meets Ash - a handsome horse riding instructor. They clash immediately. Emma tries to prove herself and goes too far. When a horse falls ill Emma must use her powers to fix the situation. Meanwhile, Lewis asks Cleo to accompany him to a formal awards night in a limo.

programme.title: S01 E04
programme.desc: Emma’s in a dilemma: handsome Byron has invited her to his birthday party on his uncle’s yacht. Her girlfriends tell her it’s no place for someone who transforms into a mermaid at the slightest drop of water. But Emma willfully goes along. Afraid she’ll do something silly, her girlfriends and Lewis join the party.

programme.title: S01 E05
programme.desc: A grand holiday resort on Mako Island? Its idyllic slopes covered with concrete and the volcanic lake inside the mountain, where the mermaids first transformed, converted into a swimming pool? Only Zane’s father could have dreamed up such a development. But Emma, Cleo and Rikki aren’t going to let this happen!

programme.title: S01 E06
programme.desc: Emma loses her mermaid nature and her powers after touching some mysterious blue seaweed. Remembering what it’s like being “normal” - she used to be a passionate swimmer - she rejoins the synchronized swimming team, which is preparing a show for the Summer Solstice Festival.

programme.title: S01 E07
programme.desc: More and more plastic bags are polluting Dolphin City Bay, and the turtles mistake the bags for sea-sponges and suffocate on them. Our three mermaids, alerted by their friend Teddy the turtle, tackle the problem. After some unsuccessful attempts, they and Lewis decide to use stronger methods to stir up public opinion.

programme.title: S01 E08
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a violent storm, Dolphin City looks like a new Bermuda Triangle: boats mysteriously break down or sink in the bay. At the sight of hordes of journalists, the girls investigate, with Lewis’ help. They find out that a lightning bolt from the storm has activated mysterious crystals whose magnetic field disrupts navigation equipment.

programme.title: S01 E09
programme.desc: When Emma, Cleo and Rikki find out two superstars – Brad Patinson and Scarlett Belladonna - are shooting a film in Dolphin City, directed by the famous Martin Fabiola, they try anything to get on the set. Luckily Zane has been hired by the production! Only Rikki prefers to approach the stars in her own way – underwater of course!

programme.title: S01 E10
programme.desc: Murray and Burke are inconsolable: their pal Danny the octopus has disappeared! By chance, Cleo finds out that he’s in fact been captured by the Oceanic Center, who are conducting scientific research. Murray puts pressure on the mermaids to get Danny out of there and bring him back to the sea. But Danny doesn’t want to go home.

programme.title: S01 E11
programme.desc: Why has a whale calf run aground on an isolated beach near Dolphin City? And what’s causing the girls’ migraines? Does it have anything to do with the dolphin twins’ bizarre sickness? During their investigations the mermaids come across a strange fishing boat using illegal technology: an extremely low-frequency military radar device.

programme.title: S01 E12
programme.desc: Burke the hammerhead shark has broken a tooth. To sooth the pain, he has to come up for air at the surface regularly: but in so doing, he involuntarily shows his fin. Before long a panic wave runs through the citizens of Dolphin City, who think they’ve got a dangerous shark on their hands.

programme.title: S01 E13
programme.desc: Rikki has to make up for her mistakes! Convinced that her father’s new girlfriend, Cathy, is dishonest, Rikki sabotages the dinner in which her father tried to ask Cathy for her hand in marriage. To bring the estranged sweethearts back together, Rikki absolutely has to recover the lost engagement ring, which fell into the sea during that tumultuous dinner.

programme.title: S01 E14
programme.desc: Worrying events agitate the little underwater community of the Bay: clownfish are inexplicably disappearing one after another. The mermaids try to get to the bottom of this mystery, to find their friend Ziggy, a little clownfish who’s among those missing.

programme.title: S01 E15
programme.desc: Cleo is down in the dumps: she might lose her job at the Oceanic Center, since she said she’s allergic to water, to avoid getting wet in front of Mr. Lambert. Swimming out at sea, she wanders into a strange stone circle – suddenly she wishes she could forget all about this mermaid business. Her wish comes true.

programme.title: S01 E16
programme.desc: It’s Valentines Day! Lewis and Abby spend the day together like sweethearts. Cleo goes crazy with jealousy. She finds out that Lewis has promised to tell Abby a huge secret. And what if – blinded by love – Lewis were to betray Cleo and her friends, by revealing that they are mermaids?! Emma, Cleo and Rikki have to get to the bottom of this

programme.title: S01 E17
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the Bay are overwhelmed: one of the dolphin twins, Robby, has disappeared, captured by an unknown speedboat. Bernie calls on our three mermaids for help: the girls were walking around Dolphin City, which is all decked out for the carnival. But why would anyone kidnap a dolphin?

programme.title: S01 E18
programme.desc: In her sleep Cleo creates huge spheres of water that float through the air in Dolphin City, causing chaos. This strange phenomenon is caused by her worries about her Dad, who is on a mission out at sea. And what if Cleo’s worries are real? What if her Dad really has fallen into the hands of dangerous outlaws involved in illegal fishing?

programme.title: S01 E19
programme.desc: The girls find some turtle eggs on Dolphin City beach: they are too fragile to move, so they take turns watching over them till they hatch. But that's not counting with Miriam and Zane – who are having a beach party!! Meanwhile, underwater, Bernie, cannot bear all the noise and disruption his neighbors are making, and decides to leave his cave and go and stay elsewhere for a bit of a rest.

programme.title: S01 E20
programme.desc: The White Mermaid is in danger! Her sanctuary, the sunken galleon of Edward the Cruel, is about to be discovered by Stanley Finch, the famous explorer. The girls decide to stop him, and make his boat take another course, towards the sinister underwater stone circle.

programme.title: S01 E21
programme.desc: After being carried by a current into the underwater stone circle, Rikki is victim of a terrible spell: she cannot turn back into a human! To break the spell, she has to wait for the full moon – in three days’ time!

programme.title: S01 E22
programme.desc: The Bay prepares for a great excitement: there's soon to be the first great robotics competition organized by the Dolphin City University. The events will take place underwater, and Lewis wants badly to win first prize: enrolment in the Science Faculty! Unfortunately, Zane is also participating, and true to form, can only do it by cheating.

programme.title: S01 E23
programme.desc: Emma’s kid brother Elliott happened to see Rikki’s mermaid tail in the water! He starts telling everyone he’s seen a sea monster. To cover up, the girls and Lewis start building a fake monster, to make people think it was all a hoax. But it’s too late – the whole town’s out looking for the famous “Dolphin City Monster”.

programme.title: S01 E24
programme.desc: The Vandals are carrying out a nasty plan: they have enlisted a terrible horde of stinging jellyfish to sow terror in the Bay. But the mermaids aren’t able to respond: Rikki grounded, wrongly accused of calling in a fire alarm at school, and Cleo has to help care for swimmers stung by the jellies.

programme.title: S01 E25
programme.desc: A lunar eclipse makes Cleo lose her power!! Lewis tries to get it back using scientific methods, but he runs into a lot of trouble! Meanwhile, Teddy the kid turtle has got into trouble with Bernie and the other animals in the Bay after playing too many practical jokes.

programme.title: S01 E26
programme.desc: The famous explorer Stanley Finch, is back in Dolphin City, with an amazing hi-tech mini-submarine. He’s decided, this time, to find Edward the Cruel’s sunken galleon. Lewis gets enrolled as Stanley’s assistant in the little submarine, and tries to stop him. But he triggers an accident.

programme.title: S01 E01
programme.desc: Country-girl Tara Webster travels to Sydney to audition for the prestigious National Academy of Dance. It’s a tumultuous week as she realises her dream of becoming a dancer is going to be a lot more difficult.

programme.title: S01 E02
programme.desc: Tara arrives at the Academy excited about the year ahead but soon discovers that she is the worst dancer in the class. As Tara struggles to fit in, she learns the hard way to respect her teachers.

programme.title: Bebefinn Good Morning Song
programme.desc: Wake up, Bebefinn! It’s morning time! What should we do when we first wake up? First, let’s do a big morning stretch—reach, reach, reach! Next, it's time to make the bed—pat, pat, pat! What comes after that? Let’s learn the perfect morning routine together with Bebefinn!

programme.title: Baby Shark's Job Adventures
programme.desc: Baby Shark is trying on all kinds of cool jobs! But watch out—the mischievous Dr. Octopus is trying to ruin the fun, bringing tons of wild and chaotic trouble! Can Baby Shark bravely solve the puzzles, save the day, and protect his friends and town? Dive into a thrilling career adventure full of excitement. Ready, set, let's go!

programme.title: Pinkfong's Farm Animals
programme.desc: Welcome to Pinkfong’s farm! You're watching "Pinkfong’s Farm", fun and educational Animal Songs presented by Pinkfong! Learn all about different farm animals with all-new Pinkfong's Animal Songs!

programme.title: Let's Booksplore with Hogi-Space
programme.desc: What happens in the library at night? Colorful books are flying all over there! Let's booksplore with Hogi.

programme.title: Baby Shark Toy Car Project
programme.desc: Welcome to Baby Shark Car Mechanic! You're watching "How to Make Baby Shark Car? ", an educational and interactive series prepared for you by Pinkfong!

programme.title: Dance Adventure
programme.desc: Arrr-! Are you ready for a fun adventure? Come and let's sing and dance together! Arrr-!

programme.title: Pinkfong Halloween Songs
programme.desc: Boo hoo! Let's celebrate Halloween! From zombies, ghosts, mummies, your favorite monsters are ALL HERE.

programme.title: Pinkfong Police Game
programme.desc: Join Police Officer Pinkfong and Ninimo to catch the naughty thief!

programme.title: Ninimo Animal Songs
programme.desc: Pinkfong's new friend Ninimo! Shall we sing animal songs together?

programme.title: Pinkfong Sing-Along Movie 2
programme.desc: Pinkfong and Hogi decide to hold a wonderful concert with Wonderville friends, showcasing each of their favorite songs! However, while preparing for the tour, Team Wonderstar begins arguing as they are getting tired from practicing due to differences in opinions while preparing the stage… Will Pinkfong and Hogi be able to overcome various conflicts and difficulties to deliver the perfect show?

programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of Oxbury, Ontario, the Giant Pig Smokehouse opened in 2019, bringing Southern barbecue to life. The journey began in 2018 on Melissa's 30th birthday during a trip to Mexico when her brother proposed the idea of opening a restaurant. Embracing their love for smoked foods and recognizing the local events like Vankleek Hill Fair and Rib Fests, they decided to share their culinary passion beyond their home. The Giant Pig Smokehouse offers a variety of Southern barbecue dishes, with pulled pork poutine and brisket poutine being top sellers. Their pulled pork is described as sweet, saucy, and flavorful, often served in sandwiches or on poutines. The authenticity of their poutin gravy, made with meat drippings, is a highlight for many patrons. Customers praise the establishment for its delicious food and the welcoming atmosphere. Bianca from Gatineau, who tried the brisket poutine, found it amazing and fulfilling. McKenna and Matt from Alberta and Stoweville, Ontario, also shared their positive experiences, highlighting the quality of the barbecue and the friendly service. The owners emphasize the importance of patience in barbecue, advocating for slow cooking and marination to achieve the best flavors. They share their journey from backyard barbecues to a full-fledged restaurant, driven by their love for barbecue and the joy of sharing their creations with others. Working with family has its challenges and rewards. While the bond and trust are invaluable, there are moments of bickering that can be mistaken for conflict by customers. Despite these moments, the family's dedication to their craft and to each other shines through. The Giant Pig Smokehouse is not just a restaurant; it's a family business where love and dedication are infused into every dish. The secret to their success lies in the love and flavor they put into their food, ensuring every meal is as cherished as if it were served to their own family.

It's all in the One Big Recipe.

programme.title: Whats On - 7 - Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

The performance blends Strauss's intense musical drama with a fresh and dynamic staging.

programme.title: Whats On - 7 - Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

programme.title: Gold Cuisine EP 4
programme.desc: Chryso Lefou makes a light and tasty Mediterranean dish with fresh pasta, colourful mint pesto, and juicy cherry tomatoes. She makes crispy fried almond fingers (Dactyla) for dessert, which adds a nutty, sweet finish. A delectable blend of decadent treats and savoury, fresh flavours.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Barcelona
programme.desc: Barcelona, Spain, is a city close to Malini's heart. Returning after her student years, she retraces old steps to see how the city has changed. Barcelona, one of Europe’s most visited cities, still holds centuries-old charm. Malina's old haunts include El Gòtic, Sant Antoni, Passeig de Gràcia, and Barceloneta. visits Gaudí’s iconic Casa La Pedrera, and discovers the new wave of creative tapas restaurants in El Raval, a once run-down quarter now bursting with energy.

programme.title: Made in Med: Legacy of stone sculpture
programme.desc: From rough blocks of stone to expressive works of art, Reuben Mallia reveals the patience and skill behind traditional Mediterranean stone carving. Fadi steps into his world to discover how simple tools, careful craftsmanship, and countless hours of work can bring solid rock to life.

programme.title: Rick Steves Europe
programme.desc: We explore the dramatic castles, prehistoric cave paintings, and prized cuisine of the Dordogne River Valley, with its unforgettable blend of man-made and natural beauty.

programme.title: Opera - Salome
programme.desc: The 87th Festival of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino opens with Richard Strauss's Salome, conducted by Alexander Soddy. Directed by Emma Dante, this new production features Lidia Fridman as Salome, Anna Maria Chiuri as Herodias, and Nikolai Schukoff as Herodes. The performance blends Strauss's intense musical drama with a fresh and dynamic staging.

programme.title: Mediterranean Yoga Start Your Day Gently
programme.desc: Mediterranean Yoga is a series that blends Embodiment Yoga with the peaceful beauty of the Mediterranean. Set in stunning coastal and natural locations, each episode encourages viewers to reconnect mind and body through gentle movement, breathwork, and mindfulness in a safe and calming space.

programme.title: Memoirs 28 Nov
programme.desc: Memoirs 28 Nov

programme.title: Whats On - 8 - Books Literature Innovation and Learning
programme.desc: Great ideas are the lifeblood of the Mediterranean and this week we are following them from the written page to the boardroom. We start at the Malta Book Festival, where the local community gathers to celebrate the stories that define the islands. Our journey then takes us to Cyprus for the Nicosia Book Fest to see how literature creates a unique bridge between cultures. In Spain, we wander the famous leafy avenues of the Madrid Book Fair, where Retiro Park becomes one of the largest outdoor libraries in the world. We wrap up at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for the EU Startup Summit, where the creative energy of storytelling meets the high-stakes world of global innovation. This is a look at the parks and the halls where the next chapter of the Mediterranean is being written.

programme.title: Fadi Abou Rjeili Sirena
programme.desc: A heartfelt musical tribute to Malta, celebrating the island’s distinctive character, cultural heritage and enduring connection with its people. Set against the backdrop of the Mediterranean, this music video captures the beauty, spirit and identity of the Maltese Island.

programme.title: Med Minds 10 Julius Caesar
programme.desc: Julius Caesar, the formidable leader of ancient Rome, became a lasting symbol of ambition, power, and transformation, shaping the destiny of the Mediterranean world through conquest, vision, and a legacy that endures beyond his dramatic fall.

programme.title: World Spas
programme.desc: Jamie Srubis tries many different spa treatments, which leave her skin glowing, at the Movenpick Resort in Jordan.

programme.title: Timeless Tamil Nadu
programme.desc: During her travels across Tamil Nadu, Alex finally reaches one of India’s most famous pilgrimage sites – Madurai. She pays her respects at the nerve center of the city – the Meenakshi Amman Temple. Her exploration of Madurai reveals to her, however, that there is another, rather delightful side to this revered city.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Sabrina Chakici visits the city of Ganja in Azerbaijan, where she uncovers the history at sights like Heyder Aliyev Park and Mausoleum Nizami.

programme.title: Xplore
programme.desc: So far Cambodia has been seasoned with adventure, local spice and colour, now encounter ancient history of the country at the Angkor Complex.

programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.desc: Røros, a historical Norwegian copper mining town full of impeccable wooden buildings, is a place that makes you travel back in time. Jamie Lowe strolls around the quaint town and checks out the mining museum to learn about the town’s fascinating history. Following this, he goes through Lærdal Tunnel, the world’s longest road tunnel, on his way to Flåm. Upon reaching, he goes to the Flåm Railway Museum, where he gets to know the exciting stories behind building the world's steepest railway.

programme.title: XP Guide
programme.desc: Stockholm, the capital and largest city of Sweden, was built on 14 Islands. This place is also sometimes referred as Venice of the north.

programme.title: World Spas
programme.desc: At Maya Ubud Spa Resort, Jamie Srubis tries different spa treatments that induce the same tranquility which Bali does.

programme.title: Timeless Tamil Nadu
programme.desc: A town defined by medieval grandeur, Karaikudi transports Alex to the era when affluent Chettiar merchants built splendid mansions as a status symbol. At one of these mansions, the secrets of the Chettinad cuisine, heavy on meat and heat, begin to unfold.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Sheki, the silk route city of Azerbaijan, is all kinds of indulgence, as Sabrina Chakici finds out. She learns about the unique play of colour and glass that is Shabaka, a traditional art form, and sees how beautifully it has been used in the mesmerizing Sheki Summer House. She also pampers herself with a relaxing crude oil spa treatment, and goes on to explore Khinalug Village, a hidden gem.

programme.title: Unwind
programme.desc: Successful actress and travel enthusiast, Indeya Passfield visits Kandy in search of rejuvenation. From the Zen at Sri Dalada Maligawa temple and nature therapy at Royal Forest Park in Uddawatekele to delectable Sri Lankan fare and relaxing massages at her resort, she finds it in every experience she has in Kandy. She also explores the local arts and crafts at the Kandyan Arts Association.

programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.desc: Flåm is an idyllic town sitting in a spectacular setting at the head of Aurlandsfjorden. Here, Jamie Lowe takes a train ride filled with breathtaking views along Flåmsbana, the world’s steepest railway line. He also takes a cruise to see the stunning UNESCO-listed fjord, Nærøyfjord, and goes on to experience the cuisine and ways of life of the Vikings in Njardarheimr, a Viking village in nearby Gudvangen.

programme.title: XP Guide
programme.desc: A homely place where the aroma of freshly baked bread greets you as people smoothly glide along on their bicycles. Welcome to Copenhagen.

programme.title: Timeless Tamil Nadu
programme.desc: In the last leg of her journey in Tamil Nadu, Alex visits one of India’s southernmost towns, Rameshwaram. Here, she is treated to stunning views of azure waters and coral islands that stretch all the way to Sri Lanka. What she doesn't expect to find, however, are the ruins of a ghost town sitting on a beach.

programme.title: Bliss
programme.desc: Most popular destinations of Santorini's main island are the volcano and the hot spring.This is best way to explore this island is on foot.

programme.title: Best From The Rest
programme.desc: While Hong Kong may be a haven for social media brags, a closer look at some of its most iconic attractions exposes its authentic richness.

programme.title: Unwind

programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.desc: Oslo, the 1000-year-old Norwegian capital, is a compact and fun city that offers the perfect experience of contemporary cultural life in Norway. Here, Jamie Lowe visits iconic attractions such as the Nobel Peace Center, as well as more offbeat attractions such as the miniature bottle gallery and Frogner Park, which features 200 statues created by world-famous sculptor, Gustav Vigeland. He also tries the ski jump at nearby Holmenkollen.

programme.title: Timeless Tamil Nadu
programme.desc: In the 8th century AD, a town on the Coromandel coast became a lab for the kings of the Pallava dynasty to conduct their architectural experiments. Centuries later, Alex visits the world-famous rock-cut temples and cave shrines of Mahabalipuram to explore the styles of architecture that were innovated by kings, who are often called the pioneers of South Indian architecture.

programme.title: Backpack

programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.desc: Famous journalist and explorer, Jamie Lowe visits the unofficial capital of the Northern Lights in Norway, Alta, where he encounters the two most exciting experiences the place has to offer: he witnesses the Aurora Borealis and he visits the UNESCO-listed Alta Museum with its rock carvings dating back to 7000 years ago. To get the full winter experience, he also tries reindeer sledding, spends a night at Sorrisniva ice hotel, and visits North Cape, the northernmost point of Europe.

programme.title: Timeless Tamil Nadu

At a center for making bronze statues, she is surprised to find out how ancient is the art form. The highlight of her trip, however, is a visit to a workshop for making musical instruments, where she is treated to an impromptu performance.

programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.desc: Jamie Lowe visits Tromsø, the gateway to the Arctic, where he gets to know the Arctic ways of life. He enjoys a reindeer burger, tries his hand at ice fishing, and gets a taste of the culture and cuisine of the Sami, the original inhabitants of the Arctic. He also goes to Bodø, where he witnesses one of the intense whirlpools created by Saltstraumen, one of the fastest tidal currents in the world.

Nella prima parte della puntata, Ornella visita il ristorante "Il Baluardo" nella regione Piemonte dove incontra lo chef Marc Lanteri. A Central Park, Ornella intervista la bellissima Barbara D'Urso e rivivono le emozioni del party " La dolce Vita" dove Barbara era l'ospite d'onore con Lee Curreri.

programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado
programme.desc: Siamo alla terza ed ultima parte del viaggio dei 10 anni di Brindiamo! Prima tappa Montreal. Ornella visita il mercato Jean -Talon con Aldo, per poi andare da "Vinizza" per preparare alcune pizze.

programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado
programme.desc: Ornella Fado si trova a St. George's Island, nelle Bermuda per filmare due favolosi episodi di Brindiamo! In questa prima puntata Ornella é in cucina con chef Michele Belotti e prepara alcune ricette per l'evento "Italian Night in Bermuda" che si terrà al St. George's Club.L'evento presentato da Ursula Avella, presidente della "Great Culinary Minds" e` stato un grande successo. (2015)

programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado

programme.title: Change your Destiny

I ragazzi affrontano le tre sfide previste: portare il loro pezzo migliore, la contemporary battle e la lezione di Hip hop con Mirco Giordano e Marcello Gargarelli.

programme.title: Change your Destiny
programme.desc: Terza ed ultima puntata della serie. Antonio Fini ed i suoi giudici sono pronti: chi sceglieranno per volare a NEW YORK per il prestigioso festival della danza? Ancora una volta i ragazzi devono convincere l'importante giuria con il loro pezzo migliore, la contemporary battle e la lezione di danza "tecnica Parson" con la maestra Abby Silva.

programme.title: Il CIRCOLO DEL BUONGUSTAI Con Fabio Campoli
programme.desc: Benvenuti a questo nuovo episodio del Circolo dei Buongustai! Cosa bolle in pentola? Oggi il nostro chef Fabio Campoli ci delizierà con tre ricette speciali: rotolo di riso, prosciutto e melone, risotto alla rucola con kiwi e vongole, e budino di riso. Buona visione a tutti!

programme.title: Il CIRCOLO DEL BUONGUSTAI Con Fabio Campoli

programme.title: My Talented Friends Season 1
programme.desc: Ornella Fado introduce il suo amico Geniale Sergio Furnari, e presenta un docuemntario su un suo ultimo lavoro aritistico "Covid Hero Monument"

programme.title: Eccellenze Italiane con Piero Muscari intervista a Heinz Beck
programme.desc: Piero Muscari intervista Heinz Beck, chef stellato del ristorante "La Pergola" di Roma. Heinz racconta l'inizio della sua carriera e spiega la sua visione della cucina italiana.

programme.title: Eccellenze Italiane con Piero Muscari intervista a Heinz Beck
programme.desc: Piero Muscari intervista Cesare Berlingeri, noto artista contemporaneo italiano. Cesare illustra l'importanza della sua arte e cosa vuole esprimere con la tecnica dei quadri piegati.

programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: Questa puntata fa parte della serie vintage. Ornella Fado visita uno dei ristoranti più eleganti di Manhattan a due passi da Central Park il "San Domenico ristorante". Nella cucina del ristorante Ornella assiste Odette Fada nella preparazione dei classici piatti Italiani. Ospite della puntata la giovane stilista Nicole Romano. Ornella Fado indossa alcune creazioni della sua collezione. (2007)

programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: Questa puntata fa parte della serie vintage. Ornella Fado visita una delle più belle scuole di cucine upstate in New York la "CIA" Culinary Institute of America, dove visita il ristorante "Caterina dei Medici", e con lo chef Scapin preprano alcune ricette del menù della scuola. (2007)

programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: Questa puntata fa parte della serie vintage. Ornella Fado visita Raffaele Trovato, direttore dell'IFSE, a Piobesi Torinese, oltre a visitare la bellissima scuola, Ornella prepara delle ricette con l'istruttore del centro.(2009)

programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: Questa puntata fa parte della serie vintage. Ornella Fado visita il ristorante "Il Tartufo" a Manayunk, poco distante da Filadelfia, dove incontra Al Del Bello, per preparare alcune ricette tipiche del ristorante. In questa puntata Ornella indossa i guanti da boxer per correre come Rocky Balboa sulla scalinata del museo d'arte di Filadelfia. (2007)

programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado
programme.desc: Ornella Fado si trova nel laboratorio di Urbani Truffle a New York ed invita i suoi amici chef per preparare insieme delle ricette da gustare durante le festività natalizie. In questa puntata Chef Pino Coladonato, Chef Marcello Russodivito e la giovane pizzaiola Giorgia Caporuscio. In questa edizione di Brindiamo! in my Kitchen ospite speciale la soprano Cristina Fontanelli e John La Barbera, oltre a vari ospiti del mondo dello spettacolo, e della moda. (2016)

programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado

I suoi amici chef in questa puntata son lo chef Raffaele Ronca, lo Chef Marco Chirico e il giovane pizzaiolo Ettore Toches. In questa edizione di Brindiamo! in my Kitchen la musica è dal vivo con la soprano Cristina Fontanelli ed il compositore Jhon La Barbera, tra gli ospiti di questa puntata il Fashion designer Domenico Vacca. (2016)

programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado

Visitando a midtown Chef Pino alla "La Masseria", chef Stefano e Franco a " Viceversa", a "PizzArte" incontra il pizzaiolo Roberto ed il proprietario Dario, a Queens visita "Ornella Trattoria" dove incontra Vincenzo e "Trattoria l'Incontro"dove incontra lo chef e proprietario Rocco. programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: La puntata di oggi è ricca di contenuti. Ornella Fado incontra Cristina Carrani, esperta in materia immobiliare che aiuterà Ornella a scoprire l'Isola di Capri. Dalla moda alla storia, al cibo e all'arte, Brindiamo! Edizione speciale Capri è l'episodio perfetto per festeggiare i 18 anni di Brindiamo! su NYC LIFE.

programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado
programme.desc: Ornella Fado visita Frank Gullo al suo stabilimento "Gullo Seafood" per scoprire i segreti di un polpo perfetto, per poi andare con Mr.Octoman a preparare alcune ricette in due ristoranti a New York, "Perla" e "Quality Italian". (2014)

programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado
programme.desc: Ornella Fado, si trova a Milano e visita uno storico ristorante stellato, "Aimo e Nadia", dove incontra ed intervista Stefania Moroni figlia della signora Nadia ed il signor Aimo. Nella bellissima cucina Ornella incontra due bravissimi chef come Fabio Pisani e Alessandro Negrini. Insieme preparano alcuni piatti classici del menù del ristorante di Aimo e Nadia.

programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado
programme.desc: Nel 2015 Ornella Fado ha celebrato 10 anni di produzione televisiva e di messa in onda su NYC LIFE, il canale pubblico di New York. Questa puntata raccoglie alcuni dei momenti più belli del programma televisivo Brindiamo!

programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: Questa puntata fa parte della serie vintage. Ornella Fado visita una delle pizzerie piu` autentiche di New York,con uno dei 5 forni a legna più antichi della città`. "Luzzo" Pizzeria si trova a due passi dal quartiere trendy, il Village. Con Michele Iuliano, pizzaiolo napoletano di grande esperienza, Ornella prepara delle deliziose pizze, alcune tradizionali come la classica margherita ed alcune con un twist. Ospite della puntata il giovane talento Italiano il tenore Luciamo La Monarca.(2008)

programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: Questa puntata fa parte della serie vintage. Ornella Fado visita uno dei ristoranti più belli d'Europa, "Don Alfonso 1890" dove incontra la famiglia Iaccarino. Oltre a preparare le ricette nella bellissima cucina con chef Ernesto Iaccarino, Ornella intervista Livia Iaccarino, la prima sommelier donna in Italia, la signora Iaccarino racconta la bellissima storia della famiglia di Don Alfonso, che ha fatto dell' ospitalità la sua stroria.

programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: Questa puntata fa parte della serie vintage. Ornella Fado visita due ristoranti di eccellenza, San Pietro e Masseria. Al San Pietro Ornella incontra i fratelli Bruno, con lo chef Antonio prepara delle ricette gustose del classico menù del ristorante, mentre Gerardo racconta la storia del rstorante ed il successo dei loro ristoranti. Da Masseria Ornella incontra lo Chef e Patron Pino Coladonato, e preparano delle ricette tipiche pugliesi.

programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: Questa puntata fa parte della serie vintage. Ornella Fado visita" Via Oreto", un ristorante dal cuore siciliano. Antony prepara le ricette della nonna e della mamma. Accanto la nonna a visionare tutto. In questo episodio Ornella intervsita un esperto del vino siciliano Pietro Cavallo, e parlano dell'importanza di abbinare il giusto vino ad ogni piatto.

programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: Questa puntata fa parte della serie vintage. Ornella Fado visita Gente, dove incontra Jay Mitchel un americano appassionato di Italia al punto di aprire un suo ristorante in america per far apprezzare il cibo Italiano ad i suoi clienti.

programme.title: Brindiamo!

programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: Questa puntata fa parte della serie vintage. Ornella Fado, visita il ristorante "etc.etc". nel cuore di Manhattan per preparare le ricette tipiche del ristorante con lo chef Stefano Terzi. In questa puntata l'ospite è il celebre pianista, Giovanni Allevi, reduce da un favoloso concerto al Carnegie Hall. Ornella intervista Giovanni passeggiando in carrozza a Central Park. (2005)

programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: Questa puntata fa parte della serie vintage. Ornella Fado visita uno dei ristoranti più raffinati di Georgetown, una elegante cittadina a pochi passi da Washington DC, un ristorante per osservare e per farsi osservare, in inglese si dice "To see and to be seeying". A "Cafe` Milano" Ornella incontra Franco Nushese, che racconta il suo sogno americano. Arrivato da Minori, Franco Nuschese, conquista l' America con l'alta ristorazione e il suo charm Italiano.

programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: Questa puntata fa parte della serie vintage. Ornella Fado si trova in Piemonte per scorpire il territorio e visitare alcuni ristoranti stellati. In questa puntata Ornella visita la Reggia di Venaria, dove il Re del ristorante "Dolce Stil Novo", chef Alfredo Russo prepara nella spaziosa e super moderna cucina delle prelibatezze tipiche piemontesi. Ornella visita anche la scuola di restauro e parla con la responsabile della scuola Dr.

programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: Questa puntata fa parte della serie vintage. Ornella Fado visita Al Del Bello al suo ristorante "Il Portico", uno dei ristoranti più raffinati di Filadelfia. Al racconta la sua storia di gratidudine nei confronti della famiglia Lattanzi proprietari di ristoratori italiani a New York. (2006)

programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: Questa puntata fa parte della serie vintage. Ornella Fado incontra chef Rocco Sacramone al ristorante Trattoria "l'Incontro", Chef Rocco, condivide alcune delle ricette più amate dai suoi clienti incluso una dolcissima pizza alla nutella. (2008)

programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: Questa puntata fa parte della serie vintage. Ornella Fado incontra un vero gentiluomo della ristorazione italiana a Filadelfia, Giuseppe Giuliani, patron de "La Buca". Giuseppe oltre a preparare alcune ricette toscane, racconta l'avventura dell'apertura atipica e fuori programma del ristorante per ospitare il Maestro Luciano Pavarotti in tour a Filadelfia.(2006)

programme.desc: Piero Muscari intervista Alberto Biasi, famoso artista italiano. Alberto racconta delle esperienze della sua infanzia e come queste hanno influenzato le sue opere e la sua arte.

programme.title: My Talented Friends Season 1
programme.desc: Ornella Fado, passa una giornata a New York con il suo amico Geniale, il Maestro Antonio Ciacca, e tra una chiacchierata a Lincoln Center ed una passeggiata a Central Park, arrivano al prestigiosto Pier Hotel dove il Maestro Ciacca si esibisce regolarmente. in questo episodio di "MY TALENTED FRIENDS" scoprirete la storia di successo del Maestro Ciacca in un pccolo documentario MY JAZZ LIFE.

programme.title: My Talented Friends Season 1
programme.desc: Ornella Fado introduce il suo amico Geniale Julian Gargiulo, un talentuosissimo compositore e pianista on uno spiccato senso dell'umore, Julian e` il protagnosita e regista di un documentario girato al Carnegie Hall di New York, durante una competizione ideada dal maestro Gargiiulo.

programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado
programme.desc: Ornella Fado si trova a Milano esattamente all'EXPO. Incontra un gruppo di ragazzi della regione Basilicata, che partecipano al progetto "Sano è Lucano", e hanno portato alcuni prodotti tipici della regione Basilicata, che Ornella utilizza per cucinare alcune ricette con Jasmin sulla barca, con Antonio alla libreria Mondadori di Milano, con Nicolò a "Lady Bu Bistrò", e con Fabio Pisani al ristorante stellato di Aimo e Nadia.(2015)

programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado
programme.desc: Ornella Fado si trova in una delle città più belle al mondo, Venezia, e visita il "Centurion Palace", dove incontra lo chef veneziano Massimo Livan al ristorante "Antinoo's Lounge". Con chef Massimo, Ornella prepara dei piatti ispirati ai dipinti d' arte moderna. Durante la visita al "Centurion Palace" incontra il General Manager Paolo Morra, e davanti ad un cocktail tutto veneziano Paolo racconta la storia di questo storico palazzo. (2015)

programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado
programme.desc: Ornella Fado si trova in Florida ospite di un eccezionale evento organizzato da Ursula Avella Presidente di "Great Culinary Minds". L 'evento si è svolto al ristorante "Valentino Cucina Italiana". Ospite di Ornella è il talentuoso chef Mauro Uliassi, all'epoca 2 stelle Michelin, ora 3. Ospite d'eccezione di questa puntata il cantautore Raf che incontra Ornella su una spiaggia di Miami. (2015)

programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado
programme.desc: Ornella Fado si trova a Brooklyn e visita il ristorante di Joe e chef Marco Chirico per preparare alcune specialità del ristorante. Prima di andare in cucina, Chef Marco preprare alcuni cocktail creati da lui, immaginate che chef Marco prepara i suoi liquori, come il limoncello e il mandarincello. La Happy hours al ristorante di Marco Polo è una combinazione di delizie tipiche italiane, formaggi e salumi ed una presentazione di frutti di mare, ostriche e gamberi.(2015)

programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado
programme.desc: Ornella Fado prosegue il suo viaggio culinario nel ristorante Enoteca, il ristorante si trova affianco a Marco Polo. Enoteca è il regno di Chef Marco Chirico, ed e` propio ad Enoteca che chef Marco prepara piatti sempre più originali come il Vulcano Pizza e il Cannolo Pizza (2015)

programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: Questa puntata fa parte della serie vintage. Ornella Fado visita Al Del Bello al suo ristorante "Il Portico", uno dei ristoranti più raffinati di Filadelfia. Al racconta la sua storia di gratidudine nei confronti della famiglia Lattanzi proprietari di ristoratori italiani a New York. (2006)

programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: Questa puntata fa parte della serie vintage. Ornella Fado incontra chef Rocco Sacramone al ristorante Trattoria "l'Incontro", Chef Rocco, condivide alcune delle ricette più amate dai suoi clienti incluso una dolcissima pizza alla nutella. (2008)

programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: Questa puntata fa parte della serie vintage. Ornella Fado incontra un vero gentiluomo della ristorazione italiana a Filadelfia, Giuseppe Giuliani, patron de "La Buca". Giuseppe oltre a preparare alcune ricette toscane, racconta l'avventura dell'apertura atipica e fuori programma del ristorante per ospitare il Maestro Luciano Pavarotti in tour a Filadelfia.(2006)

programme.title: Brindiamo!
programme.desc: Questa puntata fa parte della serie vintage. Ornella Fado visita una delle pizzerie piu` autentiche di New York,con uno dei 5 forni a legna più antichi della città`. "Luzzo" Pizzeria si trova a due passi dal quartiere trendy, il Village. Con Michele Iuliano, pizzaiolo napoletano di grande esperienza, Ornella prepara delle deliziose pizze, alcune tradizionali come la classica margherita ed alcune con un twist. Ospite della puntata il giovane talento Italiano il tenore Luciamo La Monarca.(2008)

programme.title: Brindiamo!

programme.title: Brindiamo!

programme.title: Change your Destiny
programme.desc: Continuano le audizioni di Antonio Fini e dei suoi giudici per selezionare i migliori danzatori da invitare al prestigioso festival di danza in NEW YORK. programme.title: Change your Destiny

programme.title: Brindiamo!

programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado
programme.desc: Ornella Fado organizza un favoloso evento al Michelangelo Hotel di New York City, ospite d' eccezione Mara Martini, ristoratrice e chef stellata veneziana. programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado
programme.desc: Ornella Fado festeggia il decimo anniversario di "Enoteca Ristorante" e con Chef Marco Chirico preparano piatti originali, tra cui la pizza tiramisù e gustosi cocktail. Ornella e Marco Incontrano Tom Perrotta a Fort Meat, grossista di carne, dove si rifornisce Enoteca Ristorante. programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado
programme.desc: Ornella Fado è ancora in Bermuda, e questa volta oltre a preparare alcuni piatti con l' executive chef del "Griffin's Bistro" Pietro Casalicchio. Ornella visita le meraviglie dell'isola via mare.

programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado
programme.desc: Ornella Fado si trova a Milano esattamente all'EXPO. programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado
programme.desc: Ornella Fado si trova in una delle città più belle al mondo, Venezia, e visita il "Centurion Palace", dove incontra lo chef veneziano Massimo Livan al ristorante "Antinoo's Lounge". Con chef Massimo, Ornella prepara dei piatti ispirati ai dipinti d' arte moderna. Durante la visita al "Centurion Palace" incontra il General Manager Paolo Morra, e davanti ad un cocktail tutto veneziano Paolo racconta la storia di questo storico palazzo. (2015)

programme.title: Brindiamo! With Ornella Fado
programme.desc: Ornella Fado si trova in Florida ospite di un eccezionale evento organizzato da Ursula Avella Presidente di "Great Culinary Minds". programme.title: Velisti per caso
programme.desc: Velisti per caso - Giro del mondo in 80 persone (Ritorno) Ep1 - Syusy è in Australia dove inizia un suo lungo giro a terra per scoprire e incontrare gli Aborigeni. Adriatica nel frattempo è a Auckland, proprio durante le regate dell’America’s Cup. Patrizio visita un po’ di Nuova Zelanda e poi in barca fa rotta verso l’Australia.

programme.title: Slow tour - Italiani non per caso
programme.desc: Gli elefanti della Sila. Strane rocce e strane grotte in Calabria, Sicilia e Puglia. A Campana, Rocella Ionica, Syusy scopre gli Elefanti di Pietra: due enormi megaliti a forma di elefante. Rocce scolpite dal vento o dall'uomo? Di roccia in roccia ci spostiamo in Sicilia, dove Patrizio a Calascibetta va cercando la Necropoli di Realmese, al confine nord della Val di Noto. Per chiudere la parabola di rocce e grotte, Syusy a Santa Maria di Leuca naviga verso Castro per vedere il tempio di Atena, il tempio di Minerva e Zinzulusa, la “grotta degli stracci”.

programme.desc: Un viaggio lento alla scoperta di Caorle, borgo sospeso tra laguna e mare Adriatico, che unisce le atmosfere della "Piccola Venezia" a un'antica storia romana

programme.title: TG del turismo
programme.desc: Nuovo appuntamento con il TG del Turismo: dal corso di scrittura di viaggio della Scuola del Viaggio alle nuove scoperte etrusche di Cerveteri, passando per il nuovo Slow Tour in Sardegna con Syusy Blady. Spazio anche alle feste dedicate al radicchio veneto, alla mostra immersiva su Cleopatra a Milano e alle nuove rubriche di viaggio di Per Caso TV.

programme.title: Velisti per caso
programme.desc: Velisti per caso - Giro del mondo in 80 persone (Ritorno) Ep2 - Patrizio visita la costa australiana, prima a Sydney e poi a Byron Bay. Con lui c’è Massimiliano Rosolino che si allena lì per i campionati di nuoto. Syusy esplora l’outback, da Coober Pedy a Ayers Rock, dove alle pendici del monte Uluru incontra il «ciclista per caso» Marco Banchelli

programme.title: Popoli del mare
programme.desc: Verso l’antica Nora - Sulle rotte dei Popoli del Mare navighiamo nel Mar Tirreno dal Lazio alla Sardegna, verso Cagliari, oltrepassando la linea di demarcazione che divideva la zona di pertinenza degli Etruschi (Toscana e Lazio) dalla zona Punico-Fenicia. La terra e le acque dei Popoli del Mare per eccellenza: Sardes e Shardana. Dal punto di vista naturalistico questa zona del Mediterraneo è un Santuario dei Cetacei, Adriatica infatti naviga per un tratto accompagnata da un gruppo di capodogli. Ma una volta a Cagliari, l'obiettivo di Syusy è raggiungere ed esplorare l'antica Nora, la prima città sarda della storia, di origine Punico-Fenicia. Nora oggi è un sito archeologico di cui la parte del porto e dei moli è rimasta sommersa dall'innalzamento progressivo del livello del mare. Ma possiamo vedere il Tempio di Tanit e cercare di ricostruire il ruolo strategico e la grandezza che doveva avere questo avamposto così protetto e privilegiato al tempo dei Popoli del Mare.

programme.title: Slow tour - Ambassador
programme.desc: Il viaggio di Italia Slow Tour Ambassador esplora il cuore autentico del Piemonte, partendo da dove la pianura si increspa per diventare montagna, lungo le tracce dell'antica Via Francigena. La prima tappa è a Settimo Vittone, un luogo intriso di storia romana e medievale, dove l'ospitalità diventa arte presso il B&B Vecchio Torchio. Qui, Elisa custodisce lo spirito della vita contadina e di una tradizione vinicola secolare, legata alla viticoltura eroica del Nebbiolo sui terrazzamenti. L'itinerario prosegue tra le colline del vino per scoprire Ca de Lion, una storica casa vitivinicola dove la passione familiare si traduce nella produzione di Barbera e Moscato, espressioni sincere del territorio. L'avventura culmina salendo ai 2000 metri del Comune di Moncenisio, uno dei più piccoli d'Italia. Al cospetto del passo leggendario attraversato da imperatori e pellegrini, e affacciati sullo spettacolare lago, incontriamo il sindaco Mauro Carena, custode di una comunità resiliente e di un confine che unisce storia, natura e futuro sostenibile.

programme.title: Syusy Blady ai confini della realtà
programme.desc: Armando Mei, giornalista e ricercatore, è parte del “progetto Kefren”, che grazie a tecnologie satellitari ha individuato strutture sorprendenti sotto le piramidi. Da anni studia l’Egitto predinastico, ipotizzando l’esistenza di un’antica civiltà avanzata, lo Zep Tepi, all’origine della nostra storia. Con lui analizziamo lo stato delle ricerche e i principali siti: piramidi, Osireion, Serapeo e altri luoghi enigmatici. Con Veronica Antili approfondiamo invece la figura di Thot, dio della sapienza presente in miti di tutto il mondo.

programme.title: I Mondi di Syusy
programme.desc: Come cambia Cuba? - Il video racconta il viaggio di Syusy Blady a Cuba in camper, documentato solo con il telefonino, da vera e propria turista per caso. Questo speciale è un'occasione per vedere e capire meglio Cuba adesso. Anche per andarci con il camper, un modo un po' insolito, prendendolo a noleggio all’Avana. Le tappe del viaggio che vedrete sono L'Avana, sia il centro che il quartiere Vibora e il Marina Hemigway. E poi Matanzas, Varadero, Vinales, Cayo Jutias.

programme.title: I Mondi di Syusy
programme.desc: Il video racconta il viaggio di Syusy Blady a Cuba in camper, documentato solo con il telefonino, da vera e propria turista per caso.
